title: Playboy August 2005 Diora Baird Guess Girl Ewan McGregor Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Light wear at the lower-left front corner; a crease at the upper-right corner of the back cover; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, August 2005. Original $4.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: Diora Baird, the Guess Girl from Wedding Crashers.

Cover features: Diora Baird pictorial - Best Guess Girl Ever; Ewan McGregor interview - the ex bad boy; Mob Tales - Jimmy Breslin on cops gone bad and the murder of Joey Gallo; Celebrate the Sporting Life: NFL preview, powerful motorcycles, the British Open, leather jackets and a crazy poker trip.

Back cover: Jose Cuervo tequila ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
